name: Rutland County, VT
findings: Rutland County has 316 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rutland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
